text: In order for TO Live to be successful and ensure that there is a stable funding source for research and development of programming initiatives (TO Live Presents), TO Live wishes to establish a Programming Reserve Fund.

The Policies and Priorities Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the creation of the Programming Reserve Fund, and its Criteria in Attachment 1 to the report (April 17, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Recommend that City Council create the TO Live Programming Reserve Fund in Attachment 1 to the report (April 17, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 3. Recommend that City Council, subject to the adoption of Recommendation 2 above, request that the City Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer transfer TO Live's 2018 operating surplus in the amount of $0.388 million to the TO Live Programming Reserve Fund as part of the 2018 year-end surplus allocations. 4.
